items.title: Emirates A380 Diverts 2,000+ Miles To London After Medical Emergency Over Russia
items.summary: Midway across Russia, an Emirates Airbus A380 faced an urgent diversion, turning a 16-hour journey into a 24-hour odyssey with a landing in London.
